description: Finding 2 (Medium) - Bearer credentials in URL query strings; audit page not cache-suppressed. (a) The admin audit-log link puts the 1-hour step-up token in the URL query string and gunicorn --access-logfile - logs it. (b) The audit-log response sets no Cache-Control despite being the most PII-dense read. (c) The OAuth RS256 JWT is appended to relying-party URLs in four 302/JSON redirect sites in app.py. Fix: convert the audit-log link+handler to POST (token in body), add Cache-Control to the audit-log response, and deliver the OAuth JWT via URL fragment (#token=) at all four sites. SAML POST path unchanged. Ordered before FEAT-004 because FEAT-004 adds a per-render verify banner to the same (now POST) audit-log handler.
steps: In identity_provider_server/admin.py ADMIN_PANEL template (~line 149) replace the audit-log anchor `Audit Log` with an inline POST form `method="post" action="/admin/audit-log"` containing hidden inputs csrf_token={{ csrf_token }} and auth_token={{ auth_token }} and a submit button styled to look like the existing link (mirror the inline action forms used elsewhere in the panel). Keep the Reload and Backups links as-is.

In identity_provider_server/admin.py change the handler at ~line 1596 from `@app.get("/admin/audit-log")` to `@app.post("/admin/audit-log")` (rename admin_audit_log_get to admin_audit_log_post). Read the token from `request.form.get("auth_token", "")` instead of request.args. Keep the `_require_admin(...)` step-up gate and the `_audit_admin(admin_user, "read_audit_log")` call.

Wrap the audit-log render in `resp = app.make_response(render_template_string(ADMIN_AUDIT_LOG, entries=entries))` and set `resp.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0"`, matching admin.py lines 798/827/1517/1821; return resp.

In identity_provider_server/app.py change all four OAuth JWT delivery sites to use the URL fragment: SSO short-circuit GET (~line 1512), MFA tail (~1715), password tail (~1930) — replace `redirect(f"{sp.url}{separator}token={token}")` with `redirect(f"{sp.url}#token={token}")`; passkey tail (~2878) — replace `jsonify({"redirect": f"{sp.url}{separator}token={token}"})` with `jsonify({"redirect": f"{sp.url}#token={token}"})`. Remove the now-unused `separator = "&" if "?" in sp.url else "?"` lines at those four sites. Leave every SAML_POST render untouched.

In identity_provider_server/static/passkey.js add a clarifying comment in wireLoginButton that result.redirect is a full URL already containing the #token fragment, so `window.location.href = result.redirect` continues to work with no logic change.

Update tests in tests/test_admin_full.py: the audit-log test near line 837 (`client.get(f"/admin/audit-log?auth_token={auth}")`) must POST csrf_token+auth_token in the body to /admin/audit-log; update test_audit_log_no_session_redirects and test_audit_log_session_cookie_without_stepup_redirects to POST; add a test asserting a GET to /admin/audit-log returns 405; add a test asserting the audit-log POST response has the no-store Cache-Control header.

Add OAuth-fragment tests (extend tests/test_app_full.py and/or tests/test_security_remediation_20261006.py): for each of the four OAuth flows assert the 302 Location (or passkey JSON redirect) contains '#token=' and contains neither '?token=' nor '&token='. Add a @pytest.mark.smoke test for the OAuth login -> fragment redirect happy path. Use the existing OAuth SP fixtures in tests/test_app_full.py / tests/test_multisp_functional.py.
acceptance_criteria: Running `source /Users/topazb/python/py314/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/test_admin_full.py tests/test_app_full.py tests/test_multisp_functional.py tests/test_passkey_endpoints.py tests/test_admin_passkey.py -q` passes.
GET /admin/audit-log returns 405; POST with a valid step-up token returns 200 with Cache-Control no-store header; POST without a valid token redirects to /admin.
All four OAuth JWT delivery sites return the token in a URL fragment (#token=), never in the query string; the SAML POST path is unchanged.
ruff check identity_provider_server/ is clean and bandit -r identity_provider_server/ -q reports 0 medium/high.
verification: python -m pytest tests/test_admin_full.py tests/test_app_full.py tests/test_multisp_functional.py tests/test_passkey_endpoints.py tests/test_admin_passkey.py -q
